description: M8 Phase 4 'sign_crop' condition. Each box [x, y, width, height] in ORIGINAL image pixel coordinates, chosen by visual inspection to contain the physical sign panel that carries the target-language text, with a small margin. Boxes were fixed BEFORE any preprocessing OCR was run and were not tuned against OCR output. The crop removes surrounding scene clutter only; it does NOT remove English text printed on the same sign.
coordinate_system: pixels of the 1600px-wide dataset images (see dataset-index.json processed_resolution)
